listing.name: Diablo (DevilutionX)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Mature native port with desktop packages and explicit original-data setup. Limits: Established Diablo/Hellfire engine; separate game data and shareware limits apply. Portcove gameplay/lifecycle untested. Upstream platforms: Official desktop runtime packages for Windows/Linux/macOS. README documents Windows x86-64, Linux x86/x86-64/AArch64 and macOS x86-64 build jobs; selected package architectures require asset selection. Original data: Own Diablo DIABDAT.MPQ, or upstream-supported spawn.mpq for limited Diablo shareware play. Hellfire expansion files are not needed for base Diablo; full-game qualification is separate from shareware. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
